findings.title: Old messages can falsely confirm a new send
findings.why_it_matters: Existing messages can be recorded as receipts for a submission that created no new message, clearing the unresolved-send retry guard. The baseline excludes hidden nodes and uses role-plus-index IDs when a provider lacks message IDs, so revealing an old node or prepending earlier history makes the same message look new. Two post-snapshot WebKit fixture regressions reproduce false observed results; the visibility regression also shows an identical retry is then allowed.
findings.validation_reason: When an existing matching user message becomes visible or preceding history changes its fallback index after preparation, the new WebPageScript.swift:31-43,67 omits or renames it and WebAgentSession.swift:181-187 falsely records observed; the inspected MultiWebAgentTests.swift:98-121 reproductions and 14-55-31/14-59-22 xcresults show observed instead of uncertain on macOS 27.2 (26B5091g), arm64, Test Scheme Action, with the visibility case also allowing an identical retry, production blobs matching full.diff, and authenticated-provider incidence unmeasured.

findings.first_evidence: MsgBlast/Core/WebProvider.swift:35 -- return original.path == homeURL.path && current.path != homeURL.path
findings.suggested_fix: Bind first-send receipt collection to the submission transaction instead of allowing any home-to-conversation snapshot. As a safe default, keep the attempt uncertain if the only matching message appears after a conversation transition that cannot be attributed to this submission; collect and pin the outgoing message ID and conversation URL as part of the page send/observation operation, and prevent user chat-navigation input while that operation is pending. Add a regression where a home-page send is followed by same-document navigation to an existing chat containing the same text, and require uncertain rather than observed.
findings.title: Switching chats can falsely confirm a first send
findings.why_it_matters: A first submission can be reported as observed using an old message from a different conversation. Start from a provider's empty home chat, submit text used in an existing conversation, and open that conversation through its SPA sidebar before the receipt poll sees the actual submission; the new URL rule accepts the unrelated conversation and its matching message was absent from the original empty ID set. This produces a false success and removes the unresolved-send protection even though the actual submission remains unconfirmed.
findings.validation_reason: When a home-page submission is followed by same-document navigation to an older conversation with one matching user message before receipt polling, newly added WebProvider.swift:32-35 accepts that unrelated route and WebAgentSession.swift:177-187 records observed without transaction attribution while WebServicesView.swift:212 leaves the page interactive; the inspected MultiWebAgentTests.swift:124-136 simulation and 15-01-23 xcresult reproduce observed instead of uncertain after history.replaceState without outgoing-message creation on macOS 27.2 (26B5091g), arm64, Test Scheme Action, with production blobs matching full.diff and authenticated-provider incidence unmeasured.
